source_families.rights_rule: Verify authorship, assignment, contributor rights, and human approval; no raw private chats or secrets.
Prefer metadata, links, and reference-only use; check exact terms before copying, transforming, or training.
Review dataset and file-level terms, content rights, privacy, provenance, quality, and intended commercial use.
Metadata discovery does not grant rights to papers, figures, code, or supplementary materials.
Check repository and file-level licenses, notices, dependencies, generated assets, and security before any training use.
Check jurisdiction, public-sector reuse terms, privacy, attribution, and third-party embedded content.
Purpose-specific consent, tenant isolation, revocation, retention, and deletion propagation required.
Record teacher/version, account terms, output-use rights, prompt recipe, filtering, human review, and contamination checks.
Isolate access and storage; never route into training, retrieval augmentation for training, or distillation.

training_method_execution.execution_evidence: Plan and job-manifest code only; no training job or weight update is claimed.
Plan and job-manifest code only; no adapter training or weight update is claimed.
Distillation remains disabled until teacher output rights, student lineage, consent, and independent evaluation are implemented.

core_modules.name: AI and machine-learning foundations
outcomes: understand supervised, self-supervised and reinforcement learning
read model cards and training/evaluation documentation

core_modules.name: Dataset discovery, quality and governance
outcomes: validate splits, hashes, duplicates, PII and provenance
practice: keep train, validation, test and private holdout isolated

core_modules.name: Instruction following and text generation
practice: measure task success and refusal correctness

core_modules.name: Translation and multilingual capability
practice: avoid treating English-only scores as universal

core_modules.name: Safety, privacy and governance
practice: verify canaries never appear in outputs

core_modules.name: Authorized reverse engineering and software analysis
practice: use owned or explicitly authorized targets
do not bypass access controls or extract secrets

core_modules.name: SFT, LoRA, distillation and checkpoint lifecycle
outcomes: train isolated division adapters or weights
practice: save periodic checkpoints and tokenizer snapshots

core_modules.name: Benchmarking and model evaluation
practice: keep private holdout out of training
